notes.title: Language Patch
notes.content:
The game has been out for a week now, and we are happy to push our first patch. It’s a minor one, unless you speak Chinese, in which case you will be happy to learn that the game can now be played in Simplified Chinese.

A few other minor issues have been fixed, some regarding translations, and others regarding some small visual glitches.

In the coming weeks, a new and more substantial patch should be delivered, with some more surprises. So stay tuned for this, and if you want to request some new features or if you witness some bugs, please jump into our Discord server and let us know.

notes.title: Localization Update
notes.content:
We identified some bugs in a couple of the localized languages. These have now been fixed.

Additionally, we have now fixed the issues with the Simplified Chinese localization! This language should now be available in-game for all players!

Thanks for playing the game!

notes.title: Wrapping up
notes.content:
We are now approaching the release date of Tavernacle! and development is coming to an end. We're excited about the result, and we can't wait to bring it to you, so you can play it on Steam, alone or with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42341346/f91dc0c6043dbd091f34f32f7f005a4a7bd0bbf0.png[/img]

The final stages of the game's creation are well underway, and we are currently translating the game into all languages and preparing the Steam achievements to make the player experience as pleasant as possible. The last few weeks have been an opportunity for us to polish the game, and bring it to a higher level of quality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42341346/77959a1900dfd95f35a3517c1100fa80f3c011e0.png[/img]

Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist, and follow us on Steam and our other social networks, to be informed as soon as news about Tavernacle! is available.

notes.title: Fresh Artworks
notes.content:
The demo has been out for a couple of months now, and we have received a ton of valuable feedback from all the people who’ve played it. We are extremely grateful for that, as it helps us a lot in polishing the game. Also, it seems you liked the plot of Waspocalypse, the first campaign of the game, and we would like to tell you a little bit more about the lore of the game. Tavernacle! takes place on the Upper-Left Earth, where weird events have been going on for some time now. It is unusual for monsters to attack the favorite tavern of our heroes. But in these troubled times, they will need to protect it against all sorts of assaults.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42341346/77959a1900dfd95f35a3517c1100fa80f3c011e0.png[/img]

In the full game, you will travel the volcanic region of Endheim, the shores of the dwarven kingdoms, and other mysterious places. Of course, every one of these biomes is home to many types of creatures, more dangerous than the wasps of the first campaign : demons, pirates, undead monstrosities and mutated animals.

Of course, killing these foes will require more and more skill, with a better strategy, while you unlock new towers and new crafting resources. Every region has their own, and the devs cruelty is such that, when you get used to one biome, you get sent to another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42341346/cb243ed964df7a4645db2b443ad76d02c75a4592.png[/img]

Skald’rik’s gluttony stretches beyond honey and eggs, so be ready to find new edible beasts as well, and to face untold perils to satisfy his appetite. Störrvald will have the opportunity for the fights he loves so much, while Lögnar accumulates gold and treasures, and Fagrastr does… whatever Fagrastr does.

On that note, we now have a couple of new artworks for the dwarves, as you can see. We’ve been working on those illustrations to help with the storytelling in the game, and wanted to give you a short preview of what it’s going to look like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42341346/4b5bf28966834e26371a942ded0c71d80e1f3817.png[/img]

notes.title: Publisher Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are proud to announce that Tavernacle! is now being published by Freedom Games [url=https://freedom.gg](https://freedom.gg)[/url]. For those of you who may not know, a game publisher can take care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing a game. That includes managing our store pages, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. Really it lets us totally focus on working to make the game the best it can be, and provides us with the resources to do so. 

You may also be concerned about horror stories of publishers ruining the vision of a game or forcing arbitrary restrictions on the dev team. For Freedom, that can’t be further from the reality we have experienced with them. Freedom has been a great partner to us, only enhancing and supporting our vision. We were very careful when considering whether to go with a publisher or not, and selected Freedom because they are committed to our vision of the game, and only want to see it reach its full potential as we see it. We maintain complete creative and development freedom, and Freedom (heh) wouldn’t have it any other way!

notes.title: Tavernacle! Livestream
notes.content:
Watch four of the developers play the game and lose their minds on some of the hardest levels Tavernacle! has to offer. The livestream will take place during Steam Next Fest, and will last for about an hour.

The demo is available and free to play, so just try it whenever you get the time! It can be played in solo or with your friends (up to four people in co-op). It offers more than an hour of gameplay, and a solid six levels to try the game and test your skills against a variety of challenges…

Don’t forget to join our Discord and to follow us on our social media to give us any feedback you might have.

And more importantly: whatever it takes defend the Tavern!

notes.title: September Demo
notes.content:
[h2]Here it comes[/h2]
On the 22nd, Tavernacle! will be releasing its first free to play demo on Steam. This is obviously a huge milestone in the development, and we are delighted to bring you a glimpse of what the game looks like.

In this demo, you will be able to play the full tutorial campaign, as well as a preview of some additional content. The game supports single and multiplayer, and you can use Steam Remote Play to enjoy it with your friends. Up to four people can join the fun, or you can go solo if that’s what you are into.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42341346/6c297b29306483bf48b882681a1fd6076e3c6f96.png[/img]

[h2]A ton of content[/h2]
We have worked tirelessly to bring you a lot of features, and to give you a good sense of what the game is about:

[list]
[*]  Controller and mouse + keyboard support
[*]  1 to 4 players
[*] 6 levels
[*] 4 types of towers
[*] 7 types of crafting materials
[*] 2 different biomes
[*] Many surprises!
[/list]

Don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/BYfBexnZjc]Discord[/url] and to follow us on our [url=https://twitter.com/DamaDamaGames]social media[/url] to give us any feedback you might have.

And more importantly: whatever it takes defend the Tavern!
